title: Air Theremin – A browser theremin you play by waving at your webcam
summary: A browser-based theremin instrument that uses webcam and computer vision to detect hand movements, allowing users to play musical sounds by waving their hands in the air without touching any physical device.
problem_solved: Makes musical creation accessible and fun without requiring physical instruments or musical training, using gesture control.
why_valuable: Combines accessibility, creativity, and cutting-edge browser technology in an engaging, interactive way that encourages musical experimentation.
